question.text: What is eye diagram, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

answer.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a formal definition of an eye diagram; they support describing it only as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity measurement or analysis item used with IL/Xtalk, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation, and as part of R&S PCB test-solutions material/stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling [19][20][22][23].
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on it
| Decision area | What depends on understanding eye diagram | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| PCIe redriver output validation | PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to listed eye-opening values; the same source gives eye-height and eye-width requirements for PCIe Gen3, Gen4, and Gen5 after equalization [5]. | [5] |
| PCIe measurement point | Minimum eye width and eye height are measured post-equalization and before 3-tap DFE blocks, so the measurement location in the signal chain depends on understanding the eye-opening context [5]. | [5] |
| PCB material / stackup selection | R&S PCB test solutions list Eye diagram under Material/Stackup selection together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling [22][23]. | [22][23] |
| High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow | The signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA explicitly includes IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram, along with TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [19][20][25]. | [19][20][25] |
| Product option / capability selection | Raw product-option text lists “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” so deciding whether that capability is needed depends on whether eye-diagram analysis is required; the passages do not identify a product model or option code for it [98][100][78]. | [98][100][78] |
| PCB layout risk assessment | A PCIe Gen5 layout source says intra-pair skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver, so layout/material decisions involving fiberglass weave, epoxy, Dk/Df variation, and skew depend on understanding eye-diagram degradation [60]. | [60] |

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCB material 與 insertion loss
[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出：

- 溫度與濕度升高時，[[insertion loss]] 會增加。
- Data rate 越高，loss 越高。
- [[Insertion loss]] 與 board material 有關。
- Ultra Low Loss material 在不同 data rate 下的 loss 低於 standard loss material。
- Megtron 6 等 ultra low-loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 預期比 nominal temperature 高最多 8%。
- FR4 等 higher loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 比 nominal temperature 高 11%。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a formal definition of an eye diagram; they support describing it only as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity measurement or analysis item used with IL/Xtalk, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation, and as part of R&S PCB test-solutions material/stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling [19][20][22][23].
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on it
| Decision area | What depends on understanding eye diagram | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| PCIe redriver output validation | PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to listed eye-opening values; the same source gives eye-height and eye-width requirements for PCIe Gen3, Gen4, and Gen5 after equalization [5]. | [5] |
| PCIe measurement point | Minimum eye width and eye height are measured post-equalization and before 3-tap DFE blocks, so the measurement location in the signal chain depends on understanding the eye-opening context [5]. | [5] |
| PCB material / stackup selection | R&S PCB test solutions list Eye diagram under Material/Stackup selection together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling [22][23]. | [22][23] |
| High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow | The signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA explicitly includes IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram, along with TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [19][20][25]. | [19][20][25] |
| Product option / capability selection | Raw product-option text lists “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” so deciding whether that capability is needed depends on whether eye-diagram analysis is required; the passages do not identify a product model or option code for it [98][100][78]. | [98][100][78] |
| PCB layout risk assessment | A PCIe Gen5 layout source says intra-pair skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver, so layout/material decisions involving fiberglass weave, epoxy, Dk/Df variation, and skew depend on understanding eye-diagram degradation [60]. | [60] |

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCB material 與 insertion loss
[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出：

- 溫度與濕度升高時，[[insertion loss]] 會增加。
- Data rate 越高，loss 越高。
- [[Insertion loss]] 與 board material 有關。
- Ultra Low Loss material 在不同 data rate 下的 loss 低於 standard loss material。
- Megtron 6 等 ultra low-loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 預期比 nominal temperature 高最多 8%。
- FR4 等 higher loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 比 nominal temperature 高 11%。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 5 dB | 14 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 8.5 dB | 28 dB | <2 dB | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 9.0 dB | 16 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 1.5 dB | 9.5 dB | 36 dB | 4–5 dB | 2–3 dB | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] crosstalk 需要被緩解，且需要納入 total channel loss 考量；Gen5 至少需要比 total system loss 增加 4–5 dB signal strength，以改善 signal-to-noise ratio 並改善目標 BER 1E-12。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a formal definition of an eye diagram; they support describing it only as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity measurement or analysis item used with IL/Xtalk, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation, and as part of R&S PCB test-solutions material/stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling [19][20][22][23].
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on it
| Decision area | What depends on understanding eye diagram | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| PCIe redriver output validation | PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to listed eye-opening values; the same source gives eye-height and eye-width requirements for PCIe Gen3, Gen4, and Gen5 after equalization [5]. | [5] |
| PCIe measurement point | Minimum eye width and eye height are measured post-equalization and before 3-tap DFE blocks, so the measurement location in the signal chain depends on understanding the eye-opening context [5]. | [5] |
| PCB material / stackup selection | R&S PCB test solutions list Eye diagram under Material/Stackup selection together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling [22][23]. | [22][23] |
| High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow | The signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA explicitly includes IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram, along with TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [19][20][25]. | [19][20][25] |
| Product option / capability selection | Raw product-option text lists “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” so deciding whether that capability is needed depends on whether eye-diagram analysis is required; the passages do not identify a product model or option code for it [98][100][78]. | [98][100][78] |
| PCB layout risk assessment | A PCIe Gen5 layout source says intra-pair skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver, so layout/material decisions involving fiberglass weave, epoxy, Dk/Df variation, and skew depend on understanding eye-diagram degradation [60]. | [60] |

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。
